title: ASOS app users receive push notifications apparently sent by hackers
summary: Fashion retailer ASOS's mobile app users received push notifications that were apparently sent by hackers, indicating a security breach in their push notification system. The incident highlights vulnerabilities in third-party notification services used by major apps.
problem_solved: This is a news report documenting a security incident, not a solution - it reports on how hackers exploited ASOS's push notification system to send messages to app users.
why_valuable: Serves as a cautionary example of mobile app security vulnerabilities and raises awareness about the risks associated with push notification infrastructure compromises.
